Home.title: Start speaking English: from your phone, at your own pace
Home.subtitle: Short video lessons, speaking practice with AI and exams with a certificate. All in one account.

steps.d: Videos and materials open on your phone. Go at your own pace, progress is saved.
Write in English any time. The partner gently corrects mistakes and explains.

steps.t: Take the exam, get a certificate
steps.d: Tests are graded instantly, written tasks are reviewed by a teacher. Certificates can be verified by number.

features.title: Everything you need in one account

items.d: Lessons by module, search across materials, comfortable on a phone.
Speaking practice without embarrassment or queues. AI replies are always labeled.
Words from a lesson become flashcards for quick review.
A hint on what to review and when, so you don't quit in week two.
Tests with instant results and tasks reviewed by a real teacher.
Issued by a teacher. Authenticity can be checked on the site by number.

level.title: Not sure where to start?
level.text: A short test shows your level and suggests the right course.

items.q: Do I need to know English to start?
items.a: No. Take the level test and the platform will suggest a course.

items.q: Can I study on my phone?
items.a: Yes. The account is designed for phones first: lessons, practice and tests work in a mobile browser.

items.q: Which languages is the interface in?
items.a: Eight languages: English, Russian, Kyrgyz, Uzbek, Kazakh, Spanish, Portuguese and Turkish. Switch in one tap.
After signing up you'll get a personal offer with a discount and can pay by bank transfer or card. You choose the payment method when you order.

items.q: Who reviews work and issues the certificate?
items.a: A teacher. AI can prepare a draft review, but a person always gives the grade and the certificate.

final.title: Start for free
final.text: Sign up and we'll send you a personal discount on courses.

footer.tagline: English from your phone: video lessons, AI practice and a certificate.
